cover.method: User-approved host-generated artwork, optimized through an AVIF transfer and decoded to a self-hosted PNG. Full composition and original dimensions retained; no cropping or regeneration. Re-encoding is lossy, not byte-identical to the original PNG.
cover.note: Illustrative artwork, not runtime evidence; the decorative avatar is not a verified portrait. Article copy and interactive implementation are unchanged.

interactive.method: Authored state-transition teaching fixture, no external calls

previousCovers.method: Original authored SVG rendered with CairoSVG; no vendor logos, model imagery, or performance measurements.
